description: This file defines the default theme for CKEditor, including functions for building the theme UI, managing shared spaces, resizing the editor, and handling theme spaces. It also includes methods for building dialogs and destroying theme elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.theme
classes.description: Defines the CKEDITOR theme with methods to build and destroy theme UI components, manage shared spaces, and build dialogs.

methods.name: checkSharedSpace
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the shared space container element for the editor.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main theme UI for the editor, including spaces and container elements.

methods.name: buildDialog
methods.description: Constructs the dialog UI for the editor.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes theme-related DOM elements and cleans up references.
